First payment date: 6/1/26
First invoice date: 5/30/26
First statement date: 6/2/26
Automation type: Standard automation

1. Sign in to Sage Intacct application.
2. Navigate to Applications > Lending Management > Loan account.
3. Click '+Create' and set up a Revolving loan account with Standard automation, Monthly invoice recurrence, Monthly statement recurrence, Origination date 5/1/26, First payment date 6/1/26, First invoice date 5/30/26, and First statement date 6/2/26. Save the record.
4. On the loan account's View page, verify the Next invoice generation date, Next statement generation date, and Loan process step fields immediately after creation.

6. Confirm that: The loan account correctly tracks its invoice/statement generation timeline: at creation Next invoice generation date is 5/30/26, Next statement generation date is 6/2/26, and Loan process step is I (Invoice). After the 5/30/26 invoice run, Next invoice generation date advances to 6/30/26 and Loan process step becomes S (Statement). After the 6/2/26 statement run, Next statement generation date advances to 7/2/26 and Loan process step returns to I (Invoice).
